name: fleet
description: Read-only AgentOps control tower CLI + MCP + serve. Local mode uses SQLite at ~/.hasna/fleet/fleet.db; cloud mode (HASNA_FLEET_STORAGE_MODE=cloud) is PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1 with all reads/writes to fleet's own config tables hitting the shared cloud Postgres. Fused upstream observability data is read-only and never persisted as source-of-truth.
